submission.bindingBasis: Planning evidence showed a clean workspace with no unreviewed local work, ready to close. The observed reviewed state matched sourceStateDigest sha256:e5d8008d22495e6f0f4e5c66c0ffe9377b031ca7c3970d2391e8076a3e62ce64. No pending local materialization preservation is needed; the intended consequence is to close and release the workspace, which is safest performed without forcing a compare-and-close on an exact digest that could now be stale.
submission.rationale: The planning evidence indicates a clean workspace (head 4e6ce637, sourceStateDigest e5d8008d...) with no unreviewed local work, and the intended consequence is to close the workspace without preserving materialization. The owner contract permits workspace.close to omit expectedSourceStateDigest, which avoids a mismatch failure from a possibly changed digest since planning time. Since the close only releases local materialization (no semantic data mutation requiring a guard), committing an unbound close is the correct action. A bound close could fail not_committed if the digest changed, which would needlessly prevent the intended consequence.
